phase: 9B.1 — real accounts, cloud career, My EraClash

results.name: the account layer declares one version on both sides
one module owns the flag; nothing else reads the provider environment directly
with no provider configured the build reports itself disabled, with a reason
the server reports configuration as booleans only — never a key or a fragment
no fake account can succeed while disabled: every call goes through withProvider
the test adapter is a test double and is imported by nothing under src/
guest play needs no account: Chaos Clash and the Daily are GUEST capabilities
no serverless function was added: twelve routes plus middleware
the cloud actions live on the existing career route
the new client-rendered routes are gated by the preview middleware and served by the SPA
